update_log: Baseline initialization of the 12 Schedules of the Indian Constitution, highlighting key subjects, specific states, and relevant constitutional amendments for Polity Static GK.

schedules.key_details: Contains the names of the States and Union Territories along with their territorial jurisdiction.
Deals with the salaries and allowances of the President, Governors, Chief Judges, Judges of High Courts and Supreme Court, and the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG).
Contains the forms of Oaths or Affirmations for Union Ministers, Parliament Election Candidates, MPs, Supreme Court Judges, CAG, State Ministers, MLAs, and High Court Judges.

schedules.subject_matter: Allocation of Seats in Rajya Sabha
schedules.key_details: Details the allocation of seats in the Council of States (Rajya Sabha) to the States and Union Territories.
Provisions relating to the administration and control of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes (excluding the four states mentioned in the 6th Schedule).
Provisions relating to the administration of tribal areas in the states of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram (AMTM).
Contains three legislative lists: Union List (originally 97, now 100 subjects), State List (originally 66, now 61 subjects), and Concurrent List (originally 47, now 52 subjects).
Lists the 22 official languages recognized by the Constitution. Originally, there were 14 languages; others were added by the 21st, 71st, and 92nd Amendments.

schedules.subject_matter: Validation of Certain Acts and Regulations
schedules.key_details: Added by the 1st Amendment (1951) to protect land reform laws and abolitions of the Zamindari system from judicial review on the grounds of violation of Fundamental Rights.
Added by the 52nd Amendment (1985). Contains provisions as to disqualification on the ground of defection for Members of Parliament and State Legislatures.
Added by the 73rd Amendment (1992). Contains 29 functional items placed under the jurisdiction of Panchayats (Rural Local Government).
Added by the 74th Amendment (1992). Contains 18 functional items placed under the jurisdiction of Municipalities (Urban Local Government).
